description: Shell script for testing interaction with Perforce (P4) case-folding features, including creating repositories, testing case-insensitive file system behavior, and cloning repositories with different case names.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a P4 server with specific options.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets the client view for p4.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a git repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

calls: p4 submit -d "Add initial lc and UC repos"
p4 submit -d "Cannot add file differing only in case" lc/FILE.TXT
